image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, light-grey rocky surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots and bands. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad, and the limbs are splayed out, showing short digits. The tail curves to the left, ending in a rounded tip.
